name: ssh-connect
description: One-click SSH from the moddeck side bar: /ssh connect|shell|status|disconnect opens your terminal on a host from ~/.ssh/config, so you type any password or 2FA code yourself. macOS, Linux and Windows.

enabled.title: Enable /ssh
enabled.description: Turn off to make /ssh do nothing.

defaultHost.title: Default host
defaultHost.description: A Host name from your ~/.ssh/config, used when /ssh is given none. Empty: the only host in your config, or a list to pick from.
